lastThread: Your last thread paused on a closed door.

hero.headline:
A story
only for you
hero.body:
Describe what you want to read,
and your story begins.

ROMANCE.title:
Contract
Marriage
ROMANCE.prompt: A contract marriage begins out of mutual necessity. They agreed there would be no feelings, but every day together makes that promise harder to keep.

ROFAN.title:
Chosen by
the Duke
ROFAN.prompt: After waking inside a novel, you meet the cold duke who was supposed to be the villain. For some reason, he only draws closer to you, and the original story starts to unravel.

FANTASY.title:
The Weakest
Was Supreme
FANTASY.prompt: Everyone dismissed the one person with no powers. But an ancient awakening begins, revealing a strength the world never knew existed.

WUXIA.title:
The Last
Swordsman
WUXIA.prompt: Ten years after vanishing from the martial world, a swordsman takes up his blade again to uncover the truth behind his master's death.

MYSTERY.title:
The Painter's
Last Canvas
MYSTERY.prompt: A renowned painter vanished the night his final work was completed. Hidden inside the unfinished canvas is a clue no one has noticed yet.

HISTORICAL.title:
Joseon's
Hidden Officer
HISTORICAL.prompt: In Joseon, a woman hides her identity to join the police bureau. While chasing a series of disappearances among noble families, she steps into a royal conspiracy.

MODERN_FANTASY.title:
The Shop of
Last Words
MODERN_FANTASY.prompt: At the end of a Seoul alley is a shop with no sign. Its owner delivers the final words of the dead. Tonight, a new visitor knocks.

SF.title:
The Last
Earthling
SF.prompt: After humanity's fall, one astronaut survives alone. On a nameless planet, they search for a way home and encounter something unexpected.
